svg.aria-label: A cello and a bass clarinet taken apart in isometric fine line, playing: keys pressing and strings vibrating, beside a score and waveforms drawn in ASCII.
svg.title: A cello and a bass clarinet, taken apart and playing.

g.text: A cello and a bass clarinet, taken apart
spruce, maple, ebony · grenadilla, nickel silver · exploded isometric

text.tspan: carved for no reason but beauty: curiosity
no frets to hide behind: years of practice
turns the strings’ pull into voice: leading
unseen, it holds the shape: mentoring
one steel point on the floor: grounded
a thin, honest voice shapes all after it
same tube, a twelfth higher: developer, then lead
the lowest notes need room to ring: patience

svg.text: A duet for cello and bass clarinet,
written after dark, played here in characters.
